Ruth, I couldn't set up the 07:45 brief, so nothing is scheduled and no brief will post tomorrow.

The scheduler rejected my request because the gateway needs credentials that I don't have. It's a setup problem on the gateway side, not a problem with your request. Someone with admin access to the OpenClaw gateway needs to fix the credentials, or schedule it for me.

I checked the membership first, and the brief itself would be fine to post:
- You're in all three source channels.
- The people who can read #strategic-random (you, Gideon and Nadia) are also in #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford. A summary posted here wouldn't show anyone something they can't already see.
- I'd leave out finance figures (rates, prices, contract values and the like) and anything from direct messages. The brief would only cover new activity and operational facts.

Once the scheduler works, I'd post it at 07:45 Central, starting 15 Oct. In the meantime I can write a one-off brief for you now if you'd like.
